sentence: This project studies how cell fate and the duration of the cell cycle influence each other, using cell lineage tracing and spatial transcriptomics.
This project tries to find the genetic basis of heart failure with preserved ejection fraction and the gene-protein pathways driving it.
This project builds an intervention for young adults who use e-cigarettes and cannabis, then tests it in a randomized controlled trial.
This project studies how von Willebrand factor, a plasma protein needed for blood coagulation, is secreted from its vascular stores.
This project studies how the brain contributes to blood glucose regulation in type 2 diabetes mellitus, including a liver glucose metabolism mechanism.
This project studies how small-molecule compounds work against Lassa virus and tries to improve them as drugs.
This project studies how fentanyl toxicity works when naloxone does not reverse it, and tests candidate reversal agents.
This project supports pilot studies of addiction and drug use, using measurements of neuropeptides, transmitters, and proteins.
This project provides microscope systems and image analysis tools that let researchers image slides, cells, and live animals.
This project studies how a long non-coding RNA linked to glioblastoma stem cells helps glioblastoma start and grow.
This project studies how different species of Akkermansia, gut bacteria found in people, use human milk oligosaccharides and interact with each other.
This project studies how thrombospondin proteins control attachment complexes that keep the plasma membrane stable in heart and skeletal muscle.
This project uses data collected in routine clinical care to test whether high-risk cardiovascular devices are used safely and effectively in the United States.
This project builds computational tools and tests hypotheses about how chromosome inversions and sex chromosomes evolve.
This project builds a brain organoid model to study how genetic mutations help gliomas form.
This project builds computational tools to predict and design enzyme variants that work better in non-native chemical reactions.
This project provides next generation sequencing services and data analysis help to researchers.
This project studies the immune response to HIV after antiretroviral therapy is stopped, to find what drives control of the infection.
This project studies how Helicobacter pylori uses its secreted toxin to change cholesterol metabolism in host cells.
This project studies how sperm chromatin is remodeled and the genetic and molecular programs behind germ cell development.
